notes:
Autosave on every form, and the keyboard no longer hides "Add new"

- Whatever you type is kept on the phone. If you press Back, close the box or leave the app, it is still there when you open the same form again.
- Works in Shift Entry (each machine), Expenses, Pocket, Trade Credit (customer, credit, payment) and Tank stock.
- A blue note says "Brought back what you typed". Tap Start over to clear it.
- If saving fails (no internet), your typing is kept, not lost.
- Shift Entry no longer asks "Continue the draft?". Your typing just comes back.
- Adding a new credit customer, Online source or POS machine: the name box and Add button now stay above the keyboard.
